coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: a story loom weaves separate strands of character, setting, conflict, and emotion into the dimensional pages of one blank open book
Scene/backdrop: intimate warm-paper atelier with a calm deep navy wall and generous negative space
Subject: one compact tabletop loom feeding colored fibers into layered blank book pages, with a single orange narrative strand crossing navy and cyan threads
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with woven fiber, hand-bound paper, carved wood, and dimensional craft detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; close three-quarter view; loom and book form one unified dominant silhouette; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: imaginative, deliberate, intimate, softly backlit
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: linen thread, deckled blank paper, dark stained wood, subtle cloth weave
Constraints: book pages and every surface completely blank and unmarked; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: quill pens, typewriters, floating letters, generic author portraits, glowing books, screens, decorative clutter
